title: Rite content, 2026-10 weeks 1–2 (19 Oct – 1 Nov 2026)
notes: Calendar: `docs/launch-kit-v2.md` (i), weeks 1 and 2. Rendered from `content/` against a local `wrangler dev --local` (no live-site rows). Card data built with `TODAY=2026-10-19`; every date on screen checked by `bun clips/check-cohorts.ts` (cohort clips + card facts sweep).

Regenerate (from `content/`): `TODAY=2026-10-19 bun clips/check-cohorts.ts`; `bun clips/render-clip.ts --only aries-three-pass-1997,aries-approach-1997,aries-last-degrees-1998,taurus-2028,celeb-lisa-1997 --stills`; `TODAY=2026-10-19 ONLY=cohorts bash remotion/render-all.sh` (then `ONLY=quotes`, `ONLY=carousels`, and `ONLY=verticals VERTICALS="CohortCard:aries-first-return CohortCard:aries-1998-99 CohortCard:aries-second-return QuoteCard:aries-sign-line"`); `bun scripts/export-batch.ts --plan scripts/plan-2026-10-weeks-1-2.json --dest 2026-10-weeks-1-2`.

**Domain flag:** every asset and caption says **rite.report** (the kit's CTA and the intended launch domain), but rite.report is **not live yet**; the site is at rite.mickreal.workers.dev. Don't post until the domain resolves, or swap the captions' link for the workers.dev URL (the burned-in text can't be swapped without a re-render: `SITE=… bun remotion/scripts/build-data.ts` for cards; clips need the `lines` in `clips/cohorts.json` edited).

**Voiceover:** none. Dial clips are silent (a silent AAC track is included for schedulers) with burned-in captions; the VO voice is still Mick's decision. Add a trending sound or VO in the app if wanted.

**Not rendered (need a person on camera):** Thu 22 Script 6, Mon 26 Script 7, Tue 27 Script 6 re-cut, Fri 30 the closest-turn piece (style 3 talking heads); Sat 31 the "one line to carry" quote card (needs a real reader's line with permission; none in hand). Sat 24 Lisa (style 5 green-screen) needs a creator: the backdrop screenshot and a captioned dial clip of her dates are provided as a stand-in.

**Time-sensitive captions:** Tue 20 clip says "Today: 10° Aries" (true to 20 Oct; Saturn is 9.99° on 21 Oct, so the site shows 9° from then): post it on the 20th, not later. Sat 24 Lisa clip says her second pass is "today, 24 Oct 2026": post on 24 Oct only. Cards say "open now" (true until 12 Apr 2028).
Text-only posts (X / Threads, Reddit) are listed with no file; their copy is the kit's, verbatim. Reddit bodies are long: copy them from the kit (f) and read each subreddit's rules that day.
